thread:
morgan: Quick check — who is owning the SDK + sample-app rollout for tomorrow's patch? release-notes cutoff is 10:00 PT. need owners, any blockers, and CI status.

ash: I can own SDK publish. will run through the packaging smoke this evening. npm + pip builds are green locally.

lee: I can take sample-apps. planning a quick e2e tonight; main blocker is the telemetry flag toggle (needs infra change).

priya: Telemetry toggle PR is staged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/412 — needs infra perms from @jordan to apply to staging. CI passed but blocked by deploy role.

jordan: noted. I can grant deploy role after 4pm PT. tagging dev-ops: @dev-ops-bot please queue an infra deploy to staging once role is granted.

dev-ops-bot: queued deploy job #staging-2026-03-16-18:05. logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/1234 — will post when finished.

sam: small heads-up — sample-apps rely on SDK v0.9.3 features for streaming handlers. if sdk publish delays, sample-apps will fallback to polling; tests will fail.

ana: (typo) ana: @sam good call. if there's any delay we should gate the sample-apps jobs behind an explicit config flag `USE_POLLING_FALLBACK=true` so we don't break the rollout.

ash: publishing plan: 
- cut tag: v0.9.3-rc3
- npm publish (public/private dist-tags)
- build wheel, upload to s3 + pip index
- update SDK YAML in sample-apps repo to tag rc
I'll run the tag at 7pm PT and start uploads.

morgan: perfect. two clarifications: 1) who is doing the release-notes entry? 2) who is watching canary?

lee: I can draft the release-notes entry — will add short breaking notes re: streaming protocol tweak and telemetry opt-in.

priya: I can watch canary once the infra deploy completes. I will monitor latencies + error rates on the console dashboards and post a 30min check-in.

jordan: infra deploy to staging done. dev-ops-bot reports no errors. awaiting ash tag/publish.

dev-ops-bot: deploy completed successfully at 1932504620. health: all services green.

ash: tag pushed and npm publish started. logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/publish/789. wheels uploading. ETA ~5m.

sam: running sample-app smoke now against rc tag. small flake in streaming tests (timing), but retrying.

lee: added USE_POLLING_FALLBACK env to CI for sample-apps just in case. pulling logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/sampleapps/321.

morgan: thanks everyone. final checklist before cutoff: 
- release-notes draft (lee) ✅ 
- SDK published (ash) — please confirm when done 
- sample-apps e2e (lee/sam) — report pass/fail 
- infra toggle (jordan/priya) ✅ 
- canary watch (priya) — post 30min update
If any of these slip, we postpone release-notes publish until we confirm.

ash: SDK publish complete. npm dist-tag "next" points to v0.9.3-rc3, wheels uploaded. publishing manifest: 
```
name: redwood-sdk
version: 0.9.3-rc3
artifact: s3://redwood-pkgs/sdk/0.9.3-rc3/
```

priya: canary 15m in: latency stable, no error spikes. will post 30m summary at 1932504920.

sam: sample-apps e2e passing headless run with rc tag after a retry. streaming flake appears resolved by a small timeout bump.

lee: release-notes entry pushed to drafts: https://www.internal.redwood/release-notes/drafts/0.9.3 — feel free to add edits.

morgan: great. I'll publish release-notes at the cutoff 10:00 PT assuming no regressions in the next 30m. thanks all. :thumbsup:
